description: A ground-level photograph depicting a broadleaved swamp forest or wetland ecosystem. The foreground shows a fallen tree trunk partially submerged in light green, stagnant water, which is extensively covered by aquatic vegetation such as duckweed. Multiple slender-trunked trees, some with visible roots, emerge from the water, accompanied by various shrubs and clumps of grass or reeds. The foliage of the broadleaved trees in the background is a mix of green and autumn colours, suggesting a temperate environment. The image illustrates a waterlogged forest habitat, consistent with EUNIS class G1.4 or G1.5 broadleaved swamp forest.
